title: \"Arquiteto de Cloud #996719\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

• Implementação de pipelines de CI/CD com Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.


Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

• Implementação de pipelines de CI/CD com Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.


Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

title: SDET - Test Automation Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer (SDET) to join a Wealth Management technology team responsible for applications used by financial advisors to manage client portfolios, investment models, and portfolio rebalancing strategies.

In this role, you will primarily focus on building and expanding automated testing solutions, improving test coverage, and supporting scalable testing practices integrated with CI/CD pipelines. You will also contribute to functional validation when necessary while helping strengthen the team’s overall automation capabilities.

These systems support critical financial workflows and data-driven processes, requiring strong attention to accuracy, data validation, and analytical thinking.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Development

· Design, develop, and maintain automated test cases for UI and API layers

· Extend and enhance the existing automation framework based on Katalon Studio

· Implement automation using Playwright and modern automation frameworks

· Convert existing manual test cases into automated regression tests

· Contribute to expanding and maintaining the automated regression test suite

· Contribute to improving test architecture, automation frameworks, and engineering practices

Quality Assurance & Validation

· Create and maintain test cases, test scripts, and testing documentation

· Perform manual validation when required to support quality assurance

· Validate system functionality across portfolio management and investment workflows

· Conduct data validation and API response verification (JSON)

· Ensure test coverage across critical business scenarios and edge cases

· Analyze system behavior to ensure accuracy in data-driven and calculation-heavy workflows

Continuous Integration & Testing

· Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

· Enable continuous regression testing as part of the development lifecycle

· Contribute to improving release confidence and deployment quality

Collaboration & Quality Improvement

· Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA engineers

· Identify quality risks early and communicate them clearly to the team

· Suggest improvements to testing strategies and automation frameworks

· Contribute ideas to improve automation efficiency and testing scalability


Technical Environment

Automation Tools

· Katalon Studio

· Playwright

· Additional automation frameworks when appropriate

Testing Types

· UI automation

· API testing

· JSON-based data validation

· Regression automation

Technology Stack (context)

· Frontend: Angular

· Backend: Java

· APIs: REST services

DevOps

· CI/CD pipelines

· Automated test execution during development cycles


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience in test automation engineering (QA Automation / SDET)

· Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites

· Hands-on experience with automation frameworks and scripting

· Experience with UI automation tools such as Katalon, Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks

· Experience performing API testing and validation

· Familiarity with JSON request/response validation

· Experience working with automation integrated into CI/CD environments

· Strong understanding of test design principles and test case development

· Ability to work effectively in Agile development environments

· Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, especially when validating complex data and calculations

· Ability to test complex workflows and algorithm-driven systems

· Advanced/Fluent English


Nice-to-Have Qualifications

· Basic programming or scripting experience (Java or similar)

· Experience with financial systems or wealth management platforms

· Exposure to portfolio management or trading systems

· Experience working with data-heavy or analytics-driven platforms

· Experience scaling automation frameworks in enterprise environments

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers

title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Desenvolvedor Java com AWS


Local: atuação remota

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Sobre a Vaga:

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Buscamos profissionais para atuar no time de Engenharia de Cloud responsável por desenho, migração, implementação e sustentação de ambientes em nuvem (Azure ou AWS).

Você trabalhará em um contexto altamente automatizado, seguindo padrões corporativos e boas práticas de arquitetura, operações e governança, apoiando a evolução contínua dos ambientes e aplicações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Migração e Implementação

  • Conduzir migrações de workloads do on-premises para cloud
  • Implementar novas soluções em nuvem desde o desenho até a entrega
  • Criar ambientes base e automatizar provisionamentos

Operação e Sustentação

  • Resposta a incidentes e gestão de problemas em serviços cloud
  • Monitoramento de infraestrutura e aplicações
  • Gestão de patches e manutenções programadas
  • Administração de backup e recuperação
  • Gestão de requisições de mudança (change requests)
  • Otimização de performance e custos
  • Manutenção corretiva/evolutiva e redução de dívida técnica

Plataforma e Integrações

  • Orquestração e gestão de containers (Kubernetes)
  • Manutenção de integrações e APIs
  • Automação de processos e infraestrutura

Colaboração e Governança

  • Seguir padrões e processos corporativos definidos
  • Produzir documentação técnica
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar profissionais menos experientes


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência como Cloud Engineer / Cloud Administrator
  • Experiência sólida em ao menos uma nuvem pública (Azure ou AWS )
  • Forte conhecimento prático em:
  • Redes e conectividade
  • Segurança em cloud
  • Gestão de identidades e acessos
  • Provisionamento de serviços
  • Experiência comprovada com Terraform (IaC)
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e GitOps
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e serviços gerenciados (AKS/EKS)
  • Programação para automação (preferencialmente Python )
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação profissional
  • Organização, autonomia e priorização de atividades
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma independente
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio
  • Compromisso com documentação e qualidade
  • Interesse em mentorar e compartilhar conhecimento

Diferenciais

  • Certificações:
  • AWS DevOps Engineer Professional
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional
  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Experiência com ambientes altamente automatizados e padronizados

Informações adicionais

CONHEÇA NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS


Alguns dos nossos benefícios são flexíveis para que você possa distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades, interesses e momento de vida. São eles:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens);
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível e Uber, 99);
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação, shows e outros);
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.

Outros benefícios:

  • Birthday off;
  • Gympass;
  • Clube Alelo com diversos descontos em lojas e farmácias;
  • Licença Maternidade de 180 dias;
  • Licença Paternidade de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê;
  • Vale Transporte conforme a demanda do projeto ou área;
  • Programa de bônus anual;
  • Comissionamento por indicação de novos clientes.


Na BIP, acreditamos que enfrentar desafios é o primeiro passo para a transformação!

Somos uma consultoria internacional de origem italiana, com projetos em mais de 40 países, com mais de 6.000 BIPers no mundo e uma atuação consolidada no Brasil. Já conduzimos mais de 700 projetos, unindo estratégia, inovação, tecnologia e sustentabilidade para gerar impacto real nos negócios e na sociedade.


Vivemos o Here to Dare todos os dias, acreditando que se desafiar é essencial para evoluir. Buscamos pensar diferente, agir com propósito e gerar valor duradouro que impacte clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e a sociedade. Cada BIPer assume o protagonismo na construção de um futuro melhor, reconhecendo que, juntos, somos capazes de conquistar muito mais.


Nossos valores são o guia que orienta nossas decisões, molda nossos projetos e reforça nosso compromisso de deixar um legado positivo em tudo o que fazemos. São eles:


We dare to think and act differently: buscamos novas perspectivas e soluções inovadoras.

We create long lasting value: comprometemo-nos com resultados duradouros e que tragam valor para nós, clientes e sociedade.

We are create of our own future: assumimos protagonismo na construção de um amanhã melhor.

Together we go further: valorizamos colaboração e trabalho em equipe para grandes conquistas.


Nosso propósito é construir, junto com nossos clientes e talentos, um futuro mais inovador, humano e sustentável. Valorizamos a diversidade, o protagonismo e o espírito colaborativo. Aqui, suas ideias são valorizadas, você encontra espaço para crescer e tem a chance de atuar em projetos relevantes, ao lado de grandes empresas de diversos setores.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM
  • 12-month contract with potential extensions


Job Description:

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join a growing AI and data engineering team focused on building production‑ready AI products. This role sits at the intersection of data/ML pipelines, MLOps, and applied generative AI, supporting initiatives such as forecasting, inventory intelligence, and conversational/agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands‑on, comfortable moving from prototype to production, and excited about building scalable ML/AI systems. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data and machine learning pipelines to support AI‑driven products and analytics. Develop and productionize LLM‑based solutions, including conversational and agentic AI use cases. Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, and deployment workflows. Collaborate on AI prototyping efforts, rapidly validating ideas and transitioning successful prototypes into production systems. Work with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to support AI workflows and automation. Support initiatives related to forecasting and inventory intelligence, including contributions to a unified UI that explains what forecasts are and why they are generated. Partner closely with data engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, business‑facing AI solutions. Contribute to cloud‑based architectures, with exposure to Azure (primary) and GCP (emerging footprint) as part of an upcoming cloud migration.



Required Skills:

- 5+ years of experience in ML Engineering

- Strong experience with Python for data and machine learning development.

- Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and pipeline development.

- Hands‑on experience building data/ML pipelines (minimum baseline expectation).

- Solid understanding of MLOps, including CI/CD practices for ML systems.

- Experience working with LLMs and modern AI tooling (e.g., ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs).

- Familiarity with LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration of AI workflows.

- Experience working in cloud environments, primarily Azure, with some exposure or interest in GCP


Compensation: $20-24/hour Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Senior
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:


  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD
  • PLR

title: OT Generalist
description:
Pay: 10k-13.5k Brazilian Reals per Month

Title: Travel OT Generalis

Location: Brazil (70% travel)

Openings: 1

Start date: ASAP


Must Have:

  • 3+ years in an OT (industrial) environment within IT functions - Technical knowledge of OT systems and infrastructure
  • Specialization in at least one OT area
  • Versatility in OT tasks
  • Cybersecurity knowledge
  • Must be able to travel at least 70% of the time


Job Description:

The OT Generalist is a versatile role responsible for a wide range of tasks within the operational technology environment. This includes conducting health reviews, evaluating server infrastructure, creating domain controllers, and working with the network engineer to do on-site network configuration and troubleshooting. The OT Generalist will also be involved in creating and managing OU structures, GPOs, and DNS reverse lookup zones.


Key Responsibilities:

  • On-Site cutover of systems.
  • Conduct secondary health reviews of domains.
  • Evaluate server infrastructure capacity and request quotes for new equipment if needed.
  • Create and configure domain controllers and trusts.
  • Manage OU structures, GPOs, and Sites and Services.
  • Create and connect process machines to appropriate domains.
  • Ensure proper patching and security tool setup for all machines.
  • Specialize in at least one area of OT to provide deep expertise when needed.
  • Install and configure security tools as needed.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência no relacionamento direto com clientes
  • Background técnico, preferencialmente em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Customer Service Representative (Portuguese)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Handle customer inquiries via live chat, email, and other channels regarding accounts, trading, payments, etc.
  • Assist customers with KYC verification, account security setup, and dispute resolution.
  • Accurately document and escalate customer issues, collaborating with technical teams for complex cases.
  • Stay updated on futures trading rules and promptly communicate platform announcements/risk alerts (training provided).
  • Adapt to shift schedules (if required) to ensure coverage during target market hours.
  • Willing to work weekends and irregular hours which will include night shifts.


Requirements


  • Have an online customer support experience, and proficiency in tools like Zendesk/LiveChat.
  • Fast learner, able to master derivatives trading terminology quickly.
  • Patient, resilient, and skilled in de-escalating high-tension situations.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian/Portuguese user communication styles; finance or customer service experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is essential.

title: Facebook ads
description:
Company Description

We suggest you enter details here.

Role Description

This is a part-time remote role for a Facebook Ads Specialist. The individual in this role will design, execute, and manage Facebook advertising campaigns to drive engagement, conversions, and growth. Responsibilities include conducting audience research, implementing ad strategies, monitoring campaign performance, and optimizing ads based on analytics. Collaboration with the marketing team to align advertising goals and creating reports on key metrics is also expected.

Qualifications
  • Proficiency in Facebook Ads Manager and knowledge of ad campaign setup, targeting, and execution
  • Strong understanding of audience research, data analysis, and campaign optimization techniques
  • Ability to create compelling ad copy and visuals in collaboration with design teams
  • Experience in digital marketing and strategic ad placements, especially for e-commerce or service-based platforms
  • Strong communication, problem-solving skills, and ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Familiarity with analytics tools like Google Analytics or similar platforms is a plus
  • Prior experience with paid social advertising or related roles is preferred

title: Supervisor Comercial | Investimentos e Seguradoras
description:
Vaga: Gerente/Supervisor Comercial – Parcerias (Seguros ou Investimentos)


Regiões: Sul e Sudeste

Base flexível conforme região de atuação


Estamos em busca de um profissional com forte perfil comercial e experiência no desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas no mercado financeiro.

A posição será responsável por expandir e fortalecer o relacionamento com corretores de seguros, assessorias, escritórios de investimentos e instituições financeiras , contribuindo para o crescimento da operação na região.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e fortalecer parcerias comerciais
  • Atuar na expansão de negócios com corretores de seguros, assessorias ou escritórios de investimentos
  • Gestão e acompanhamento de indicadores comerciais
  • Apoio e desenvolvimento de parceiros na comercialização dos produtos
  • Apresentações comerciais e estratégicas


Buscamos profissionais com experiência em:

  • Mercado de seguros e corretores
  • Mercado de investimentos e assessorias financeiras


Requisitos

  • Experiência em posições comerciais ou de gestão
  • Forte networking no mercado financeiro
  • Conhecimento em apresentações corporativas (Excel e PowerPoint)
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (dependendo da região)


Modelo de contratação: PJ


Vem ser #ancorado!

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: PLM Architect
description:
About us :

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Responsibilities

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • You will analyze customers’ business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions.
  • You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture.
  • You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed.
  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.
  • You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes.
  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.
  • You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule.

Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired.
  • Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals.
  • Be customer service oriented.
  • Have programming skills, preferably in Java.
  • A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training.

Must Have Skills

  • 5-10+ years’ experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • Participated in PLM Implementation projects.
  • Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor’s or master’s Degree Level)
  • Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed

title: Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer
description:
Role Description of Senior Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer / Hands on Architect


This is a remote contract role for an Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer. In this role, the developer will design, develop, and maintain ETL processes and workflows using Informatica Cloud. Responsibilities include integrating various data sources, performing data modeling activities, ensuring the quality of extracted, transformed, and loaded data, and troubleshooting issues within the ETL process. Additionally, the developer will collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and support the analytics and reporting needs of the organization.


Qualifications of Senior Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer / Hands on Architect

  • Proficiency in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and experience with ETL tools
  • Strong skills in Data Integration and Data Modeling
  • Excellent Analytical Skills for problem-solving and data analysis
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud tools is highly desirable
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Experience in finance or data-driven industries is a plus
  • An Informatica Cloud Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration solutions using Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) and Informatica Data Management Cloud (IDMC)
  • The role involves working closely with data architects, analysts, and IT teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and accessibility across cloud and on-premises systems
  • Design & Develop data integration workflows and mappings using IICS/IDMC
  • Collaborate with data architects and analysts to understand data requirements
  • Maintain & support existing data integration solutions
  • Optimize and enhance performance of data workflows and mappings
  • Implement data quality and governance policies
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data integration issues
  • Document data integration processes and workflows
  • Ensure data security, accuracy, and compliance

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Climate and Energy Study (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Gen Z who are interested in participating in market research on Climate and Energy topics. The market research will be conducted in pair with your friend.



Qualifications:

  • Able to talk about the climate and the energy sector or have no deeper understanding on the Energy system
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 60-minute interview conducted via MS Teams
  • Please note that you will be conducting the interview session with as a pair with your friend.


Compensation package - BRL 530 for a 60-minute online Interview per person.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • One of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry has a need to develop, support and integrate software system in Oil & Gas domain.
  • You will be a member of a cross functional team.
  • Key project stakeholders are open for innovative ideas.
  • Project is based on SCRUM methodology.
  • This is a great opportunity to work in an international team, apply and learn modern IT technologies


Responsibilities:

  • Application Security with strong AI/ML security exposure
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for AI systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
  • Protection against prompt injection, adversarial ML, data poisoning, and model abuse
  • Secure SDLC and CI/CD integration, including MLOps pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security automation
  • Strong collaboration with development and data science teams


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years in Application Security, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML security
  • Strong secure coding and vulnerability management background (OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java
  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or Spark
  • Strong communication skills


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory services
  • Firewall and security group administration practical experience.
  • Good understanding of AICPA SOC2 controls and processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of network security and protocols.
  • Knowledge of cryptography protocols and hands-on experience in SSL certificates generation.
  • Penetration testing hands-on experience in Azure and AWS cloud environments and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Web and desktop applications penetration testing hands-on experience.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: System Engineer Sr/IT-OT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for System Engineer Sr/IT-OT Integration .


In this role you will:

Install, commission, and integrate IT–OT environments in life sciences manufacturing. Blend hands-on industrial automation with secure networking, clear documentation, and cross functional collaboration.

  • Install, commission, and support IT-OT and related IT application solutions in production.
  • Develop and maintain UNIX shell and Windows scripts for automation and operations.
  • Configure secure industrial networks and OT→IT data flows; ensure reliability and compliance.
  • Connect platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ; HighByte advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus.
  • Design system architectures; produce clear installation/integration diagrams and runbooks.
  • Collaborate in agile teams; engage confidently with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Databases: Install, design and query across SQL and NoSQL stores; support historian connectivity.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture Documentation tools.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving and methodical troubleshooting.
  • Proactive, detail oriented team player in agile environments.
  • Fluent English.

title: Analista de negócios sênior (ArcGIS)
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.

  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;

  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.

title: Backend Engineer (Java + SAP Commerce Cloud)
description:
Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Java + SAP Commerce Cloud)


Location: Remote

Short-Duration Project

Industry: E-commerce

Team: International and Multidisciplinary


We are currently looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Java and SAP Commerce Cloud experience to join an international e-commerce project within the beauty and professional haircare industry. This is a short-term engagement with high impact, working on a modern digital commerce ecosystem supporting a globally recognized premium brand.

You will join a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing and optimizing backend services that power large-scale e-commerce platforms. The project focuses on scalability, performance, and integration within a microservices-based architecture.


Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop backend services within SAP Commerce Cloud environments

• Build scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot

• Contribute to architecture decisions and propose optimal technical solutions

• Work closely with cross-functional teams following Agile methodologies

• Ensure high-quality code through testing, CI/CD pipelines and best development practices

• Support integration across the e-commerce ecosystem and backend platforms


Tech Stack

• Java

• ⚙️ Spring Boot Microservices

•

title: Arquiteto Soluções - GCP
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Soluções com sólida experiência em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , migração para cloud e gestão e modernização de aplicações. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar soluções utilizando ferramentas GCP (como BigQuery, Vertex AI e Gemini). Você atuará em projetos estratégicos de transformação digital, projetando soluções escaláveis para gerar valor a partir de dados e IA em ambientes corporativos complexos.

Além de forte expertise técnica, buscamos um perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de se envolver com equipes de negócios, arquitetura e engenharia.



Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e apoiar a implementação de pipelines de dados e fluxos de machine learning usando ferramentas nativas do GCP (BigQuery, BigQuery ML, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, etc.).
  • Identificar modelos preditivos e generativos apropriados usando BigQuery ML, Vertex AI e Gemini para resolver desafios de negócios dos clientes.
  • Projetar soluções para criar, treinar, monitorar e manter modelos em produção com foco em desempenho, escalabilidade e governança.
  • Colaborar de perto com engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e stakeholders de negócio para entender requisitos e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Projetar e apoiar a implementação de soluções que automatizem processos de ingestão, transformação e análise de dados, acelerando a entrega de insights de negócio.
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e apoiar o repasse de conhecimento para equipes internas e clientes.
  • Contribuir para a evolução das melhores práticas de arquitetura de dados e IA no GCP. Espera-se que você faça a mediação entre áreas de negócio do cliente e equipes técnicas.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas.



Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos
  • Plano odontológico
  • Programa de remuneração variável
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)
  • Terapia online
  • Massoterapia
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro
  • Day off no seu aniversário
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)




Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: .

Acesse aqui o nosso aviso de proteção de dados para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos.

Privacy Notice


The personal data collected will be used exclusively for the recruitment process and processed according to the security guidelines introduced by Atos.

If you have any questions related to privacy or any aspect related to processing activities, you can contact us by e-mail: .

Click here to access our privacy notice and to get to know more about Atos processing of personal data.



Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Essa é uma oportunidade também para vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Analista de qualidade sênior
description:
Analista de Qualidade Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e

proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como QA Sênior você será referência estratégica e técnica dentro da Squad, além da confiabilidade de nossos produtos. Liderando a estratégia de qualidade, definindo processos que antecipam riscos e garantem entregas de alto impacto. Será responsável por colaborar com

Tech Leads e Arquitetos para integrar a qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida do software (SDLC). Além de dominar testes manuais e automatizados, atuará como mentor do time, disseminando boas práticas, otimizando a base de conhecimento e elevando o padrão técnico da organização.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar scripts e frameworks de testes automatizados para aumentar a eficiência do ciclo de entrega;
  • Atuar como referência técnica (mentor) para desenvolvedores e QAs menos experientes, apoiando decisões junto a Tech Leads e Arquitetos;

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Google Ads Account Manager (MCC) – Remote


About the Position:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Google Ads Account Manager to oversee and optimize multiple client accounts using MCC (My Client Center). This is a remote opportunity for someone experienced in managing campaigns and improving performance through data-driven strategies.


Key Responsibilities:


Manage and optimize multiple Google Ads accounts through MCC


Plan, launch, and monitor campaigns across Search, Display, and YouTube


Conduct keyword research and develop effective ad copy


Analyze campaign performance and implement optimizations


Manage advertising budgets to ensure efficient spend


Prepare performance reports and share insights with stakeholders


Identify opportunities to improve overall campaign results


Qualifications:


Experience managing Google Ads campaigns (MCC experience is an advantage)


Understanding of key metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

title: Consultor SAP MM
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP MM para atuar em projetos estratégicos e sustentação de processos em ambiente industrial. A atuação envolverá melhorias e suporte nos módulos SAP MM com interface direta com áreas de Suprimentos, Logística e Operações. O candidato deve ter conhecimento em processos de compras, gestão de estoque, MRP , inventário e integrações logísticas, incluindo alçadas de aprovações. É essencial ter experiência ou vivência em SAP EWM apoiando processos de armazenagem, movimentação e controle de estoque. O levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, desenho funcional e especificação técnica são partes importantes do trabalho, assim como o acompanhamento de integrações com outros módulos como FI, CO, SD e PP . Também é necessário atuar nas integrações com sistemas legados, fretes, importação e demais sistemas industriais, oferecendo suporte a testes integrados, go live e estabilização.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Ter pós-graduação completa é um diferencial relevante, assim como conhecimento funcional em EWM . Além disso, vivência em ambiente industrial, um perfil analítico, proativo e com boa comunicação são desejáveis. Capacidade de atuar próximo às áreas de negócio com visão de processo ponta a ponta é muito valorizada. Conhecimento em ABAP será considerado um diferencial relevante.


Resumo dos requisitos: SAP MM , SAP EWM , MRP , FI , CO , SD , PP , ABAP .

title: Dev Sênior Mobile Android
description:
A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Arquiteto(a) Sênior Mobile Android – Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform – Android XR com bom nível de idioma inglês para integrar nossa equipe e ajudar a construir aplicações móveis modernas e multiplataforma.

Você trabalhará com Jetpack Compose, Compose Multiplatform e Kotlin Multiplatform (KMM/KMP) para criar experiências integradas e fluídas para Android e iOS.



O que você fará:

  • Criar produtos digitais inovadores para dispositivos móveis, desde smartphones e tablets até óculos inteligentes com IA
  • Conduzir a evolução sustentável e a melhoria contínua da plataforma mobile
  • Gerenciar requisitos técnicos



O que esperamos:

  • 4 a 6 anos de experiência como Lead/Arquiteto(a) em desenvolvimento Android
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação
  • Sólida experiência com Kotlin, Android e Jetpack Compose
  • Familiaridade com Kotlin Multiplatform (KMM/KMP) e desenvolvimento multiplataforma
  • Conhecimento de MVVM, injeção de dependência (Koin/Hilt) e gerenciamento de estado
  • Experiência com frameworks de mock/teste e desenvolvimento orientado a APIs
  • Paixão por código limpo, reutilizável e por princípios modernos de UI/UX
  • Alto interesse em IA, LLMs e tecnologias emergentes



Diferenciais:

  • Experiência inicial com óculos de IA
  • Interesse elevado ou motivação intrínseca por óculos AR/IA



Por que se juntar a nós:

  • Trabalhar em aplicativos mobile multiplataforma de ponta
  • Colaborar em um time moderno, ágil e criativo
  • Influenciar a arquitetura e o design de bibliotecas compartilhadas e componentes de UI
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver suas habilidades em desenvolvimento multiplataforma, testes e tecnologias de IA/AR.


Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!



Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!
